notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Izzet Boilerworks and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
